critique_summary: The fleet is currently suffering from severe cross-bot correlation in short positions and a 'stop-loss cascade' effect on Kraken. Aggressive bots show non-viable win rates (<22%), while Oracle exhibits conviction inflation where 0.90+ scores result in significant losses (BITO -8.3%).
critique_flags: Aggressive Kraken bots (Blackbeard/Calypso) have win rates below 22%
Excessive short-side correlation on SNX, STRK, and STX across three bots
Oracle conviction inflation on crypto-linked assets
High stop-out frequency on RENDER and ALGO suggests these assets are too volatile for current ATR settings
